entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain with thunderstorms possible. Amounts may exceed warning criteria in isolated areas. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch
entry.summary: A showery unstable airmass is expected to develop over the lower South Island this afternoon and evening. For southern Southland, and inland parts of Clutha and Dunedin, there is a moderate risk of severe thunderstorms with localised downpours of 25-40 mm per hour. Rainfall of this intensity can cause surface and/or flash flooding, especially about low-lying areas such as streams, rivers or narrow valleys, and may also lead to slips. Driving conditions will also be hazardous with surface flooding and poor visibility in heavy rain.

entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch
entry.summary: An unstable showery air mass affect the upper and central North Island this afternoon and evening. For eastern Auckland, inland parts of Waikato, inland parts of Bay of Plenty west of Te Puke including Rotorua and northern Taupo, there is a moderate risk of SEVERE thunderstorms with localised downpours of 25-40 mm per hour. Rainfall of this intensity can cause surface and/or flash flooding, especially about low-lying areas such as streams, rivers or narrow valleys, and may also lead to slips. Driving conditions will also be hazardous with surface flooding and poor visibility in heavy rain.

entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
entry.summary:
At 05:45 pm, MetService weather radar detected severe thunderstorms near OMOKOROA, THE SOUTHERN KAIMAI RANGES and THE KAIMAI RANGES.
These severe thunderstorms are moving towards the eastsoutheast, and are expected to lie near TAURANGA, THE SOUTHERN KAIMAI RANGES, PYES PA and OROPI at 06:15 pm and near TE PUKE, PAPAMOA, OROPI, OTANEWAINUKU and PAENGAROA at 06:45 pm.
These thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by torrential rain.
Impact:
Torrential rain can cause surface and/or flash flooding about streams, gullies and urban areas, and make driving conditions extremely hazardous.
